{{Top|leg}}
'''Culpharm''' was a pharmaceutical company that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
In about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], some of Culpharm's specimen samples went missing, so [[Carlitina Semla]], it's head of security, hired the [[Heroes of Cularin]] to investigate their disappearance.<ref name="Mix and Match">{{LivingForce|Trade Wars: Mix 'n Match}}</ref> A short time afterward, Culpharm was tipped off that [[Genasys]], a rival company, was going to make a deal with the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Higgie Sethven]] to develop a new type of drug. Culpharm responded by sending a security team to the shop [[Natural]], on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], where the deal was taking place, to stop it from happening.<ref name="Find the Lady">{{LivingForce|Trade Wars: Find the Lady}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a group of Culpharm scientists were captured by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Raik Muun]], who took them to her base on [[Tilnes]], where she forced them to carry out experiments on the [[t'salak]].<ref name="Force Contention">{{LivingForce|Forces of Cularin: Force Contention}}</ref>
